status: x-y-time-only preflight frozen before fine-place same-night vertical outcome
role: post-freeze exploratory mechanism discrimination; four-panel structurally-evaluable subset only; cannot alter v0.3.8
baseline_source: corrected 2-km fine-place × speed2_turn2 structural preflight selected before vertical outcome

context.night_rule: UTC timestamp shifted backward by 12 hours, then calendar date

feasibility.self_history: other retained sessions of same individual in same cohort
feasibility.same_night_other: retained sessions on target dominant shifted night from other individuals in same cohort
feasibility.target_support: target endpoint's 2-km cell × state occurs in both self-history and same-night-other pools
feasibility.individual_evaluable: at least one target session with >=50 common supported endpoints
feasibility.panel_gate: retain at least 70% of 2-km fine-place baseline n and at least 5 individuals in every panel
feasibility.decision: If all four panels pass, freeze exact n and open vertical self-history vs same-night-other test. Otherwise stop.

planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.self_predictor: equal-session P(z_residual | 2-km cell,state) from same individual's other sessions
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.same_night_other_predictor: equal-individual P(z_residual | 2-km cell,state) from other individuals on target night
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.endpoint: mean log P_self - log P_same_night_other on common supported target endpoints
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.aggregation: equal target session within individual, then equal individual within panel
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.null: within cohort, permute whole-session individual labels preserving exact session-count multiset while keeping night, x-y-time state and centered session data attached to blocks; rebuild both predictors
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.panel_pass_rule: exact preflight n; observed-minus-null-mean self-vs-same-night gain >0; one-sided p(null>=observed)<=0.05
planned_vertical_test_if_feasible.synthesis: 3 or 4 PASS => shared calendar-night context plus 2-km route/kinematic matching is insufficient as a general explanation in this subset; 1 or 2 => mixed; 0 => shared night context may explain much.

claim_boundary: Same-night matching controls calendar-night context, not exact local weather at every fix.
Persistence does not prove intrinsic phenotype.
No inference to Eidolon or five-panel generalization.
stop_rule: Do not change 2-km grid, speed2_turn2 definition, shifted-night rule, 0.95 purity, 50-event support, 70% retention, >=5 floor or panel set after preflight.
Do not inspect vertical outcome before all four panels pass structural gate.
